scope: Exact arithmetic baseline over the same finite controls. All returned witnesses and all smaller protection-set contradictions are checked in one Lean kernel invocation. Full bounded domain and the shared proposal set stay separate. No claim of support exhaustion beyond the named domain.

import Lean
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true
set_option maxHeartbeats 100000
theorem d38_obligation : (∃ x y : Nat, x ≤ 5 ∧ y ≤ 5 ∧ (x + y = 5) ∧ (∀ z : Nat, z + 0 = z)) ∧ (¬ (∃ x y : Nat, x ≤ 5 ∧ y ≤ 5 ∧ (x + y = 5) ∧ x = 2 ∧ y = 1)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have identity : ∀ z : Nat, z + 0 = z := by intro z; exact Nat.add_zero z
    let x : Nat := 2
    let y : Nat := 3
    have hx : x ≤ 5 := by decide
    have hy : y ≤ 5 := by decide
    refine ⟨x, y, hx, hy, ?_, identity⟩
    decide
  · intro candidate
    rcases candidate with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hClaim, fixedX, fixedY⟩
    subst x
    subst y
    first | (omega; done) | (simp_all; done) | (grind; done)
#print axioms d38_obligation
